Paralyzed Pup Go- Remembering Jasper.

This channel shares Jasper’s journey. After becoming paralyzed when he was eight, for nine years he used his wheelchair and our specially designed Changing Station and Tub-Sling to live his best life. Jasper inspired us every day with his determination and joyful spirit.

The Changing Station is a supportive, multi-use devise used daily to change diapers, express the bladder and keep Jasper upright and comfortable—not to mention less stressful on my back!

It serves as a standing support for physical therapy, healthcare and grooming, It can be converted into a Tub-Sling support for bathing.

We hope Jasper’s story inspires others caring for paralyzed pets.
